en: The postcard features an Art Nouveau style illustration of a building's oriel window (bay window projecting from the wall) adorned with red flowers. The top of the oriel has a red-tiled roof, and below is an arched entrance with a small table and chair. The drawing has clean lines and limited color palette (red, yellow, grey, black). The text 'ERKER AUS' and 'RATTENBERG' appears at the top of the postcard.
